newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Talks on for 15 pct Ho Wah Genting sale.
newsitem.headline: Talks on for 15 pct Ho Wah Genting sale.

text.p: A major shareholder has been approached to sell a 15 percent stake in precision engineering service firm Ho Wah Genting, it said in a statement released on Monday by the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
Ho Wah Genting said negotiations are currently in progress between Happy Theme Sdn Bhd and the unnamed party.

A separate approach had been made for the purchase of shares owned by Happy Theme Sdn Bhd, Ho Wah Genting Berhad and substantial shareholder Lim Hui Boon amounting to about 41.1 percent of the company in aggregate, but those negotiations were not successful and had been terminated, Ho Wah Genting said.
Ho Wah Genting's share price fell Singapore $0.28 to S$1.08 on Monday. On Friday it had risen sharply, with dealers citing rumours of a takeover attempt as a factor.
